Our team publishes practical guides about running a small online business. We explain how to choose a domain name, set up hosting, write product descriptions and measure results with simple analytics. Every article is reviewed by an editor and updated when the advice changes. Readers can ask questions in the comments and we answer them within two working days. This guide covers the first ninety days of a new shop, including the tasks that matter most and the mistakes we see most often.
